example_sentences_in_bangla: রাগে তার মুখে দন্তবিকাশ হয়ে গেল।
এই খবর শুনে সে দন্তবিকাশ করে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: In anger, he started gnashing his teeth.
Upon hearing the news, she ground her teeth in frustration.
note: The idiom figuratively conveys intense anger or irritation, implying no further 'teething' or patience needed, rooted in everyday Bengali expressions of emotion.
